notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Possessed Skaab and Great Whale
When Possessed Skaab and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
